Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(14) := ltrim(:control_block.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:control_block.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 ltrim(:control_block.unit_serial_no);
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(7) := :control_block.unit_serial_no; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(14) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(1) := null; 
BEGIN
 IF :con_bar_code in ('X','8') and NVL(length(temp_v_unit_id), 0) != 14 THEN
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no');
 IF NVL(length(temp_v_unit_id), 0) in ('7','10') 
 AND :control_block.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :control_block.coll_year IS NULL THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN 
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar('D'||temp_v_unit_id||'D','M',:con_bar_code,temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:control_block.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 show_error('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 show_error('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :control_block.unit_serial_no;
 :control_block.coll_id := NULL; 
 :control_block.coll_year := NULL;
 :control_block.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 message('Please re-enter unit ID.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or
 (:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND
 :control_block.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 -- go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 IF :con_bar_code in ('X','8') THEN
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :control_block.unit_serial_no;
 go_item('control_block.user_response'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
END;

 FUNCTION move_into_utrs
 (
 pl_cnt_id VARCHAR2
 , pl_test_id VARCHAR2
 ) 
 RETURN BOOLEAN 
 IS
 v_count NUMBER := 0;
 v_auto_sch NUMBER := 0;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) 
 INTO V_COUNT 
 FROM contract_tests 
 WHERE contract_id = pl_cnt_id AND 
 test_id = pl_test_id AND 
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id AND 
 --SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+1); -- SCR 18938
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+1)
 ;
 IF v_count > 0 
 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 SELECT NVL(COUNT(*),0) 
 INTO v_auto_sch 
 FROM valid_tests 
 WHERE test_id = pl_test_id AND
 auto_schedule = 'Y';
 IF v_auto_sch > 0 
 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL; 
 END move_into_utrs; 

BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lIFetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 --
 -- it is possible that interdictions were created
 -- FROM test results at a time WHEN the unit was not
 -- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id AND
 -- coll_date are going to be NULL in unit_interdictions.
 -- This is updated the first unit is checked
 -- in FROM any source. There is an inherent
 -- bug here as units FROM dIFferent chapters might
 -- actually get the same chapter_id.
 --
 UPDATE unit_interdictions
 SET chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 , coll_date = :control_block.coll_date
 , program_id = :banner.prog_name
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id AND
 (chapter_id IS NULL OR 
 coll_date IS NULL
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 MESSAGE('Error in updating unit interdictions');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 --
 BEGIN
 --
 -- it is possible that tests were created in utrs
 -- at a time WHEN the unit was not checked-in at all,
 -- specially for antigens. In such cases, the chapter_id AND
 -- coll_date are going to be NULL in utrs.
 -- This is updated WHEN the first unit is checked
 -- in FROM any source. There is an inherent
 -- bug here as units FROM dIFferent chapters might
 -- actually get the same chapter_id.
 --
 UPDATE utrs
 SET chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 , coll_date = :control_block.coll_date
 , program_id = :banner.prog_name
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id AND
 (chapter_id IS NULL OR 
 coll_date IS NULL
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 MESSAGE('Error in updating utrs - coll_date/chapter_id is NULL');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 --
 BEGIN
 --
 -- it is possible that attributes were created
 -- FROM test results at a time WHEN the unit was not
 -- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id AND
 -- coll_date are going to be NULL in unit_attributes.
 -- This is updated the first unit is checked
 -- in FROM any source. There is an inherent
 -- bug here as units FROM dIFferent chapters might
 -- actually get the same chapter_id.
 --
 UPDATE unit_attributes
 SET chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 , coll_date = :control_block.coll_date
 , program_id = :banner.prog_name
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id AND
 (chapter_id IS NULL OR 
 coll_date IS NULL
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 MESSAGE('Error in updating unit attributes');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 --
 BEGIN
 --
 -- it is possible that transactions were created
 -- in unit_test_base WHEN the unit was not
 -- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id AND
 -- coll_date are going to be NULL in
 -- unit_test_base. This is updated WHEN the first unit
 -- is checked in FROM any source. There is an inherent
 -- bug here in case of collision between unit_ids FROM
 -- two dIFferent chapters.
 --
 UPDATE unit_test_base
 SET chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 , coll_date = :control_block.coll_date
 , program_id = :banner.prog_name
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id AND
 (chapter_id IS NULL OR 
 coll_date IS NULL
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 MESSAGE('Error in updating unit test base');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 --
 -- The following block moves transactions FROM utb to utrs
 -- The sequence of utr activity is as follows:
 -- 1. Insert transcations in utr FROM profile tests
 -- 2. Insert transcations in utr FROM transactions in utb
 -- which were scheduled FROM the core routine. AND the
 -- test results have still not come. These can be
 -- identIFied by tb_id being NULL.
 -- 3. Update results FROM utb to utrs as present.
 -- 4. Transfer all reconciled tests FROM UTB to UTR(as left in UTB)
 --
 --
 -- Step .1.
 --
 insert_utrs;
 --
 -- Step .2.
 --
 BEGIN
 FOR c3_rec IN c3
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO utrs
 (
 unit_id
 , coll_date
 , chapter_id
 , test_seq_no
 , test_id
 , insert_dats
 , insert_user_id
 , program_id
 )
 SELECT :units.unit_id 
 , :control_block.coll_date
 , :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 , NVL(MAX(test_seq_no),0)+1
 , c3_rec.test_id
 , c3_rec.insert_dats
 , c3_rec.insert_user_id
 , c3_rec.program_id
 FROM utrs
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id AND 
 coll_date = :control_block.coll_date AND 
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id AND 
 test_id = c3_rec.test_id
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 MESSAGE('Error in inserting into utrs from utb');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 END;
 --
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM unit_test_base
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id AND 
 coll_date = :control_block.coll_date AND 
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id AND
 test_id = c3_rec.test_id AND
 test_seq_no = c3_rec.test_seq_no
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 MESSAGE('Error in deleting from utb - 1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 END;
 END LOOP;
 END;
 --
 -- Step .3.
 --
 BEGIN
 FOR c1_rec IN c1
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 SELECT MIN(test_seq_no)
 INTO temp_test_seq_no
 FROM utrs
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id AND
 TRUNC(coll_date)= TRUNC(:control_block.coll_date) AND
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id AND
 test_id = c1_rec.test_id AND
 result_status_1 IS NULL AND
 cancel_flag IS NULL
 ;
 IF NVL(temp_test_seq_no,0) >= 1
 THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE utrs
 SET test_state = c1_rec.test_state
 , test_mode = c1_rec.test_mode
 , result_status_1 = c1_rec.result_status_1
 , result_status_2 = c1_rec.result_status_2

 ELSE
 IF move_INTO_utrs(:control_block.contract_id,c1_rec.test_id) THEN

 , result_status_2
 , tb_id
 , test_chapter_id
 , tb_seq_no

 , absorbance

 , result_dats
 , result_user_id
 , testing_lab_code
 , insert_dats
 , insert_user_id
 , cancel_flag

 )
 SELECT :units.unit_id
 , :control_block.coll_date
 , :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 , NVL(MAX(test_seq_no),0)+1
 , c1_rec.test_id
 , c1_rec.test_state

 , c1_rec.result_status_1
 , c1_rec.result_status_2
 , c1_rec.tb_id
 , c1_rec.test_chapter_id
 , c1_rec.tb_seq_no
 , c1_rec.well_NUMBER
 , c1_rec.absorbance
 , c1_rec.ratio
 , c1_rec.result_dats
 , c1_rec.result_user_id
 , c1_rec.testing_lab_code
 , SYSDATE
 , :banner.user_id
 , c1_rec.cancel_flag
 , :banner.prog_name
 FROM utrs
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id AND

 ;
 EXCEPTION

 THEN

 END IF;
 IF move_into_utrs(:control_block.contract_id,c1_rec.test_id)

 pl_purple_flag in varchar, pl_serum_plasma in varchar2) IS

BEGIN
enable_disable;
 IF pl_tube_flag ='U' THEN
 if pl_red = 2 then
 go_item('tubes_block.r1_scan_unit_id');
 elsif pl_red =1 and pl_red_flag = 'RR1' then

 elsif pl_red = 1 and pl_red_flag = 'RR2' then

 if pl_purple =1 and pl_purple_flag = 'PP1' then

 ELSIF pl_tube_flag = 'R1' then
 if pl_red = '2' then
 go_item('tubes_block.r2_scan_unit_id'); 
 elsif pl_red = 1 and pl_red_flag = 'RR1' and pl_purple =0 then
 update_unit_block;
 resetting_tubes_block;
 elsif pl_red = 1 and pl_red_flag = 'RR2' then
 go_item('tubes_block.r2_scan_unit_id'); 
 elsif pl_red = 1 and pl_red_flag = 'RR1' and pl_purple = 2 then
 go_item('tubes_block.p1_scan_unit_id');
 elsif pl_red = 1 and pl_red_flag = 'RR1' and pl_purple_flag = 'PP1' then
 go_item('tubes_block.p1_scan_unit_id');
 elsif pl_red =1 and pl_red_flag = 'RR1' and pl_purple_flag = 'PP2' then
 go_item('tubes_block.p2_scan_unit_id');
 end if;
 ELSIF pl_tube_flag = 'R2' then
 if pl_purple = 1 and pl_purple_flag = 'PP1' then 
 go_item('tubes_block.p1_scan_unit_id');
 elsif pl_purple = 1 and pl_purple_flag = 'PP2' then
 go_item('tubes_block.p2_scan_unit_id');
 elsif pl_purple = 2 then
 go_item('tubes_block.p1_scan_unit_id');

 go_item('tubes_block.serum_plasma');
 else

 resetting_tubes_block;

 ELSIF pl_tube_flag = 'P1' then

 update_unit_block;
 resetting_tubes_block;
 elsif pl_purple = 1 and pl_purple_flag = 'PP2'then
 go_item('tubes_block.p2_scan_unit_id');
 elsif pl_purple = 2 then
 go_item('tubes_block.p2_scan_unit_id');
 end if;
 
 ELSIF pl_tube_flag = 'P2' then
 if pl_serum_plasma = 'Y' then
 go_item('tubes_block.serum_plasma');
 else
 update_unit_block;
 resetting_tubes_block;
 end if;
 END IF;
 
END;
